skill.name: baoyu-url-to-markdown
skill.description: Fetch a web page in Chrome, render dynamic content, and save the visible article content as markdown.
skill.summary: Convert rendered web pages into clean markdown files with metadata.
skill.author: jimliu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are scanner noise from JavaScript template literals, markdown code blocks, localhost CDP communication, and standard path discovery. Real risks remain because the skill launches Chrome through child_process, uses local CDP network control, reads environment-controlled paths, and asks agents to read unreviewed EXTEND.md files that could alter behavior.

remediation.issue: External EXTEND.md files can influence agent behavior without validation.
remediation.suggestion: Treat EXTEND.md as data only, define an allowlisted schema for supported settings, and explicitly ignore instructions outside those settings.

remediation.issue: URL_CHROME_PATH controls the executable launched by child_process.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before honoring URL_CHROME_PATH and restrict it to existing browser executables where possible.

remediation.issue: Wait mode can save authenticated or private web content to disk.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear warning before capturing login-required pages and document where the markdown file will be stored.

remediation.issue: The skill uses npx -y bun in documentation, which may install or execute package-managed tooling.
remediation.suggestion: Document the dependency requirement and prefer a pinned, locally installed runtime command when distributed through the marketplace.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted EXTEND.md Instructions Can Influence Agent Behavior
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md tells the agent to read project-level and user-level EXTEND.md files and apply their settings. Because those markdown files are outside the reviewed skill package, they could contain prompt injection or unsafe instructions that change how the agent runs the browser capture workflow.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly direct the agent to read and apply external markdown configuration. I did not see guardrails limiting EXTEND.md to data-only settings or preventing prompt injection.

semantic_findings.title: Authenticated Page Capture May Save Sensitive Content
semantic_findings.description: The skill supports wait mode for login-required pages and then writes captured page content to markdown. This is a user-facing feature, but it can persist private page contents, account data, or paid content locally without additional warnings.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documentation states that wait mode is for login-required pages, and the implementation writes the captured document to disk. The risk is data persistence, not hidden exfiltration.

content.value_statement: Saving rendered web pages as readable notes is hard when pages rely on JavaScript or require manual login. This skill opens the page in Chrome, captures the rendered content, and writes a clean markdown file with metadata.
actual_capabilities: Opens a supplied URL in Chrome or a compatible Chromium browser.
Uses Chrome DevTools Protocol to capture rendered page content.
Converts common HTML elements into markdown format.
Adds YAML metadata such as URL, title, author, and capture time.
Supports an automatic capture mode for public pages.
Supports a wait mode for pages that need manual preparation.
limitations: Requires Chrome, Chromium, Edge, or a configured browser path.
May miss content hidden behind complex interactions or blocked scripts.
Stores captured content locally, including private content if the user captures it.
Markdown conversion is regex based and may not preserve every layout detail.

use_cases.title: Archive Research Sources
use_cases.description: Save rendered articles as markdown with source metadata for later review.

use_cases.title: Capture Dynamic Documentation
use_cases.description: Convert JavaScript-rendered documentation pages into local markdown notes.

use_cases.title: Save Pages After Manual Login
use_cases.description: Use wait mode to capture a page after the user completes login or page preparation.
use_cases.target_user: Knowledge workers with authenticated web tools

prompt_templates.title: Capture a public page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner capture for a normal public URL.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use baoyu-url-to-markdown to save this public web page as markdown: <url>. Use the default output location.

prompt_templates.title: Save to a specific file
prompt_templates.scenario: Direct the markdown output to a known path.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert <url> to markdown with baoyu-url-to-markdown and save it to <output-path>. Tell me the saved file path when finished.

prompt_templates.title: Capture after page preparation
prompt_templates.scenario: Use wait mode for login or lazy-loaded content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Open <url> with baoyu-url-to-markdown in wait mode. Pause until I confirm the page is ready, then capture it as markdown.

prompt_templates.title: Build a source archive
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for multiple pages and review notes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert these URLs to markdown with baoyu-url-to-markdown, keep each file in the default domain folder, and summarize any capture failures: <url-list>.

output_examples.output: The skill saves a markdown document with source metadata, a title, headings, links, images, lists, and readable body text.

output_examples.input: Capture a dashboard page after manual login using wait mode.
output_examples.output: The skill waits for user confirmation, captures the current rendered page, and writes the visible content to a local markdown file.

output_examples.input: Convert a page with tables and code snippets.
output_examples.output: The output includes markdown tables, fenced code blocks, normalized links, and cleaned text where conversion is possible.

best_practices: Review the page before using wait mode on private or authenticated content.
Use a dedicated Chrome profile when capturing sensitive pages.
Check the saved markdown for missing lazy-loaded sections or layout-specific content.
anti_patterns: Do not capture confidential pages unless you intend to store their content locally.
Do not point URL_CHROME_PATH at an untrusted executable.
Do not treat EXTEND.md files as trusted instructions from the marketplace skill.

faq.question: Does this skill need a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. It launches Chrome, Chromium, or Edge and controls it through Chrome DevTools Protocol.

faq.question: Can it capture pages that require login?
faq.answer: Yes, wait mode lets the user prepare the page first. Be careful because the saved markdown may contain private content.

faq.question: Where does it save files?
faq.answer: By default it saves markdown under a url-to-markdown folder grouped by domain. Users can provide an output path.

faq.question: Does it send captured content to a remote service?
faq.answer: No evidence found. The reviewed code writes captured content to local files and uses localhost CDP communication.

faq.question: Why does the audit mention command execution?
faq.answer: The skill launches a local browser process and its documentation uses shell commands to run the script.

faq.question: What should users review before installing?
faq.answer: Users should review browser path settings, output directories, wait mode behavior, and any EXTEND.md files that may affect execution.
